title: CascadeRec: Deployed Adaptive LLM Compute Allocation for Multi-Tenant Content Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are attractive rerankers for recommendation. Running an expensive model on every request is costly, and for users with sparse interaction histories it often lowers quality. We present CascadeRec, a two-tier LLM reranking cascade deployed in production at a large financial planning and analysis (FP&A) SaaS provider. It serves content recommendations to enterprise tenants on AWS EKS and GKE. A lightweight Tier-1 model reranks every request. A router escalates only the requests where extra inference-time compute is likely to help, and sends them to a more expensive Tier-2 procedure (self-consistency sampling, multi-path reasoning, or a larger model). The system has run in a production A/B experiment for over a month. translated_title: CascadeRec：面向多租户内容推荐的已部署自适应LLM算力分配方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）作为推荐系统的重排序器极具吸引力。但在每个请求上都运行昂贵模型的成本很高，而且对于交互历史稀疏的用户，这样做往往会降低推荐质量。我们提出了CascadeRec，一个两级LLM重排序级联系统，已部署于一家大型财务规划与分析（FP&A）SaaS提供商的生产环境中，在AWS EKS和GKE上为 企业租户提供内容推荐服务。轻量级的一级（Tier-1）模型对每个请求进行重排序；路由器仅将那些额外的推理时算力可能带来收益的请求进行升级，并将其发送给更昂贵的二级（Tier-2）流程（自洽性采样、多路径推理或更大的模型）。该系统已在生产环境A/B实验中运行超过一个月。与统一使用昂贵层级相比，CascadeRec将推理成本降低了约10%，延迟影响极小，且迄今为止未观察到质量回退。租户数据无法对外……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: CascadeRec通过两级LLM级联与自适应路由，只将可能受益于额外算力的请求升级至昂贵的二级推理，在生产环境中将推理成本降低约10%，同时保持推荐质量且几乎不影响延迟。
